Frequently asked questions

A few helpful details before we begin.

Have a question about coverage, planning, or delivery? Here are some useful starting points.

How far in advance should we book?

Booking early is recommended, especially for multiday conferences. Availability is confirmed during the initial conversation.

Do you travel?

Yes. We are based in Fort Lauderdale and can travel. Any travel costs will be clearly included in the proposal.

Can you provide photography and video together?

Yes. Coverage is planned according to the event size, schedule, locations, and required deliverables.

When will the content be delivered?

The delivery schedule depends on the project scope. The exact timeline will be confirmed before the event.

What is the Interview Studio?

It is a branded space created at the conference for efficient interviews with leaders, experts, sponsors, and attendees.

How is pricing determined?

Every proposal is based on event length, coverage needs, team size, travel, and final deliverables.
